kultivator.screen.help.kultivator_liar: Rogue cultivators wear masks and fight with qi: a qi line every 6 seconds, an element burst from the Cultivator Robber up, a telegraphed mark from the Demonic Sect Elder up, and the Patriarch's Blood Seal (step out of the red ring). Wanderers and robbers flee at 20%% health. Away from any sect territory and villages, an ambush may come about once in a while from Qi Refining on (at most 15%% per check, then a quiet day): three seconds of killing intent, then 1-3 rogues ahead of you. Win and search them: every Loot Pouch rolls stones, herbs, talismans and sometimes a jade slip or a Heavenvoid fragment. They never hurt villagers, animals, pets or creative players, never open doors and never change a block (pressure plates and tripwires can still click under them). Formations hit them at ×0.6 but formation kills give nothing. Commands: /kultivasi serbuan info. Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 190, 273, 388 and 402; the genre term 散修.
kultivator.screen.help.serbuan.title: Demonic sect raids
kultivator.screen.help.serbuan: From hall level 3 a demonic sect raids your hall every few days (9 by default); an NPC sect at war with you (Sect Diplomacy) can raid the same way. Black banners at the sunset before warn you (two sunsets with an active Alarm Restriction), and no one can sleep in your territory on raid night. The raid is fought live only while you are inside your territory and not idle: 3-5 waves march on the stele, and any raider standing by it fills the Plunder Seal. Kill the channellers! Repelled: PK, demonic loot pouches in the storehouse, renown if your disciples fought, and a banner for each slain Patriarch. Held (the night runs out): half the PK. Sacked (the seal is full): at most three storehouse stacks (keys, rings, artifacts and trophies are safe) and a capped share of the Daya treasury, and duty output is halved for a day. Away or idle? The raid is settled at dawn from your defence score (disciples at the hall, running formations, the Grand Formation). Disciples never die in a raid; they are carried off wounded. Commands: /kultivasi serbuan info. Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality ch. 263 and 1203; I Shall Seal the Heavens Book 5 ch. 735.
